what: The hero photo panel opens up and down from the horizontal center line (after .4s, .6s expo.out), the tagline blocks are revealed from the left (from .8s, .6s power3.out, .1s stagger), then the white-strip voice lines over the photo are drawn from the left (from 1.5s, .4s power3.inOut, .06s stagger, text .1s later). Every 5s the voice lines lift away upward (.4s), the current section rolls up toward its top edge with its bottom edge slanted -10% (.8s expo.inOut), revealing the next section laid beneath, and then a new voice line is drawn. The order is shuffled and reshuffled after a full cycle. On narrow screens the slant is 5% and the photo zooms in to 1.08× over 7s. It pauses when off-screen
ease: expo.inOut (roll) · expo.out (panel opening) · power3.out (tagline) · power3.inOut (voice line)

options.dur · ease: Curl-up length and curve, default .8 · expo.inOut
options.slope · slope-narrow · bp: Bottom edge slant when rolled (%) — wide screen · narrow screen · breakpoint (px), default 10 · 5 · 961
options.shuffle: If off, follows the written order (default is shuffled)
options.[data-fx-part]: frame (version) > slide (section, two or more) > photo (image) · voice > bg + text (voice lines) · catch (slogan chunks, several outside the board, optional)
